SELECT p.panetype AS panel_type,
       AVG(p.powratew * p.tempcoef * (e.celltempc - 25)) AS avg_tpci
FROM panel p
JOIN environment e ON e.arearegistry = p.hubregistry
GROUP BY p.panetype

SELECT CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(g.initdate)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS panel_age_years,
       AVG(f.measpoww * 100.0 / p.powratew) AS avg_ppr,
       COUNT(*) AS panel_count
FROM panel p
JOIN plant g ON g.growregistry = p.hubregistry
JOIN performance f ON f.solmodref = p.panemark
GROUP BY CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(g.initdate)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER)
ORDER BY panel_age_years ASC

WITH plant_costs AS (
  SELECT g.growregistry AS plant_id,
         g.growalias    AS plant_name,
         g.gencapmw     AS capacity_mw,
         SUM(m.maintcostusd + m.cleancostusd + m.replacecostusd) AS total_maintenance_cost,
         SUM(m.revlossusd) AS total_revenue_loss
  FROM plant g
  JOIN maintenance m ON m.powerref = g.growregistry
  GROUP BY g.growregistry, g.growalias, g.gencapmw
),
metrics AS (
  SELECT pc.plant_id, pc.plant_name, pc.capacity_mw,
         pc.total_maintenance_cost, pc.total_revenue_loss,
         pc.total_maintenance_cost / pc.capacity_mw AS mce,
         pc.total_revenue_loss / pc.capacity_mw AS rlr,
         (pc.total_revenue_loss / pc.capacity_mw) / (pc.total_maintenance_cost / pc.capacity_mw) AS mroi,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alerts a WHERE a.compreg = pc.plant_id AND a.alertstat = 'Critical') AS critical_alerts
  FROM plant_costs pc
)
SELECT plant_name,
       ROUND(capacity_mw, 2) AS capacity_mw,
       ROUND(total_maintenance_cost, 2) AS total_maintenance_cost,
       ROUND(total_revenue_loss, 2) AS total_revenue_loss,
       ROUND(mce, 2) AS maintenance_cost_efficiency,
       ROUND(rlr, 2) AS revenue_loss_rate,
       ROUND(mroi, 2) AS mroi,
       CASE WHEN critical_alerts > 0 AND mroi > 2.0 THEN 'URGENT'
            WHEN critical_alerts > 0 THEN 'HIGH'
            WHEN mroi > 2.0 THEN 'MEDIUM'
            ELSE 'LOW' END AS priority_level
FROM metrics
ORDER BY CASE WHEN critical_alerts > 0 AND mroi > 2.0 THEN 1
              WHEN critical_alerts > 0 THEN 2
              WHEN mroi > 2.0 THEN 3
              ELSE 4 END ASC,
         mroi DESC

SELECT p.panemark AS panel_id,
       e.ffactorinit AS initial_fill_factor,
       e.ffactorcurr AS current_fill_factor,
       CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(g.initdate)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS years_since_installation,
       ROUND((e.ffactorinit - e.ffactorcurr) / NULLIF(CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(g.initdate)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER), 0) * 100, 2) AS ffdr
FROM electrical e
JOIN panel p ON p.panemark = e.engyunitref
JOIN plant g ON g.growregistry = p.hubregistry

SELECT p.panemark AS panel_id,
       p.powratew AS rated_power_w,
       ROUND(f.measpoww, 2) AS measured_power_w,
       ROUND(p.powratew * json_extract(f.efficiency_profile, '$.degradation.cumdegpct') / 100.0, 2) AS degradation_loss_w,
       ROUND(f.measpoww * e.soillosspct / 100.0, 2) AS soiling_loss_w,
       ROUND(f.measpoww * (1 - json_extract(i.power_metrics, '$.inverteffpct') / 100.0), 2) AS inverter_loss_w,
       ROUND(p.powratew * json_extract(f.efficiency_profile, '$.degradation.cumdegpct') / 100.0
             + f.measpoww * e.soillosspct / 100.0
             + f.measpoww * (1 - json_extract(i.power_metrics, '$.inverteffpct') / 100.0), 2) AS total_system_loss
FROM panel p
JOIN performance f ON f.solmodref = p.panemark
JOIN plant g ON g.growregistry = p.hubregistry
JOIN environment e ON e.arearegistry = g.growregistry
JOIN inverter i ON i.siteref = g.growregistry

SELECT g.growalias AS plant_name,
       p.panemark AS panel_id,
       g.initdate AS installation_date,
       CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(g.initdate)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS service_years,
       p.paneeffpct AS initial_efficiency_pct,
       json_extract(f.efficiency_profile, '$.current_efficiency.curreffpct') AS current_efficiency_pct,
       json_extract(f.efficiency_profile, '$.degradation.anndegrate') AS annual_degradation_rate,
       ROUND(((json_extract(f.efficiency_profile, '$.current_efficiency.curreffpct') - p.paneeffpct) / NULLIF(CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(g.initdate)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER), 0) * 100), 2) AS pelr,
       ROUND((((json_extract(f.efficiency_profile, '$.current_efficiency.curreffpct') - p.paneeffpct) / NULLIF(CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(g.initdate)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER), 0) * 100) / NULLIF(json_extract(f.efficiency_profile, '$.degradation.anndegrate'), 0)), 2) AS ndi,
       CASE WHEN (((json_extract(f.efficiency_profile, '$.current_efficiency.curreffpct') - p.paneeffpct) / NULLIF(CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(g.initdate)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER), 0) * 100) / NULLIF(json_extract(f.efficiency_profile, '$.degradation.anndegrate'), 0)) > 1.5 THEN 'High Degradation'
            WHEN (((json_extract(f.efficiency_profile, '$.current_efficiency.curreffpct') - p.paneeffpct) / NULLIF(CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(g.initdate)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER), 0) * 100) / NULLIF(json_extract(f.efficiency_profile, '$.degradation.anndegrate'), 0)) >= 1.0 THEN 'Moderate Degradation'
            ELSE 'Normal Degradation' END AS degradation_severity
FROM panel p
JOIN plant g ON g.growregistry = p.hubregistry
JOIN performance f ON f.solmodref = p.panemark

SELECT p.panemark AS panel_id,
       p.tempcoef AS temperature_coefficient,
       e.celltempc AS cell_temperature_c,
       json_extract(f.efficiency_profile, '$.current_efficiency.curreffpct') AS current_efficiency_pct,
       json_extract(e.irradiance_conditions, '$.irradiance_types[3]') AS poa_irradiance_wm2,
       ROUND(json_extract(f.efficiency_profile, '$.current_efficiency.curreffpct')
             * (1 + p.tempcoef * (25 - e.celltempc) / 100.0)
             * (1000.0 / json_extract(e.irradiance_conditions, '$.irradiance_types[3]')), 2) AS wce
FROM panel p
JOIN plant g ON g.growregistry = p.hubregistry
JOIN environment e ON e.arearegistry = g.growregistry
JOIN performance f ON f.solmodref = p.panemark

SELECT i.invertregistry AS inverter_id,
       i.pwrqualidx AS power_quality_index,
       json_extract(i.power_metrics, '$.harmdistpct') AS harmonic_distortion_pct,
       json_extract(i.power_metrics, '$.invertpowfac') AS inverter_power_factor,
       i.pwrqualidx
         * (1 - json_extract(i.power_metrics, '$.harmdistpct') / 100.0)
         * json_extract(i.power_metrics, '$.invertpowfac') AS giq
FROM inverter i

SELECT e.arearegistry AS area_id,
       e.envmoment AS measurement_time,
       e.soillosspct AS soiling_loss_pct,
       e.dustdengm2 AS dust_density_gm2,
       AVG(e.soillosspct / NULLIF(e.dustdengm2, 0)) AS avg_soiling_impact_factor
FROM environment e
WHERE e.soillosspct > 5
   OR e.dustdengm2 > 0.15
   OR (julianday('now') - julianday(e.lastcleandt)) > 30
GROUP BY e.arearegistry, e.envmoment, e.soillosspct, e.dustdengm2

SELECT g.growalias AS plant_name,
       SUM(m.maintcostusd + m.cleancostusd + m.replacecostusd) / g.gencapmw AS maintenance_cost_efficiency,
       SUM(m.revlossusd) / g.gencapmw AS revenue_loss_rate,
       (SUM(m.revlossusd) / g.gencapmw)
         / (SUM(m.maintcostusd + m.cleancostusd + m.replacecostusd) / g.gencapmw) AS mroi
FROM plant g
JOIN maintenance m ON m.powerref = g.growregistry
GROUP BY g.growregistry, g.growalias, g.gencapmw
